name: NWWA "Slamfest" (1999)
notes: Buff Bagwell retained the title the card itself calls the "United States Title" (the fed's own dedicated ledger names the same belt the National Heavyweight Championship — sources disagree on the name); Ric Flair challenged Kirk unsuccessfully for the Intercontinental Championship; Buff Tortoise won the World Heavyweight Championship from the Rock in a ladder match, with interference from a third man, Cougar, not separately minted. A backstage vignette also finds a background figure, Carl, seated near a forklift outside the Horsemen locker room during the same beatdown that introduces Jax — no action is attributed to him, and he is not minted as a character.

matches.note: United States/National Heavyweight Title match. Hill accidentally leveled the referee going for the Bang; Bagwell recovered first, grabbed the vacant title belt from the corner, and knocked Hill out with it for the pin.

Intercontinental Title match — first man to exit the cage and touch the floor wins. Miss X arrived in a Horsemen shirt and appeared to help Flair, then clocked him with the IC Title belt instead, revealed as a DX loyalist, and helped Kirk escape the cage first.

matches.stipulation: World Heavyweight Title vs Title Ladder Match
matches.note: A third man, Cougar, ran in and delivered a double chokeslam to both competitors; Tortoise reached the World Heavyweight Championship first as Rock shoved the ladder out from under him a moment too late to stop it.

name: NWWA "Fall Classic: War Games"
notes: Triple H defeated Shane Douglas in a Hell in a Cell match with an assist from Chris Jericho; the Rock retained the World Heavyweight Championship against Kirk in the main event, also with Jericho's help, while Goldberg ran in and speared Triple H.

matches.note: Chris Jericho slipped Triple H a pouch of blinding powder through the cage bars to use on Douglas; Triple H pinned him with the Pedigree seconds later.

Billed with the winner crowned World Champion and the loser crowned Intercontinental Champion — both men already held those exact titles entering the match. Triple H and Goldberg brawled to ringside during the bout; Chris Jericho, self-appointed as the show's own 'enforcer,' entered the ring and cracked the World Title belt over Kirk's head, then revived the downed referee just long enough to count the Rock's pin. The Rock retained the World Title; Kirk remained Intercontinental Champion per the match's own loser clause.

name: NWWA "Slamfest"
notes: Scott Credible won the inaugural NWWA Internet Championship in a six-man battle royal (the same card's own separate Killerwolf/Scott Durden ladder match is also billed for the Internet Championship — the fed's own script never reconciles the two results, both preserved honestly). Gorilla won the vacated International Championship from Rambacklash. Hellwolf retained the World Heavyweight Championship in a triple threat against White Tiger and Joe E. Awesome, with a heel turn from Jaymac (not separately minted) sealing the finish.

matches.note: Kid Chaos won by disqualification after Watts hit him with a chair halfway through the match.
A locked cage bout with a ref stationed on a platform above the ring, won only by submission or knockout. Payne climbed to the platform and delivered a super powerbomb for the knockout win.
For the inaugural NWWA Internet Championship. Scott Credible was never eliminated and won the title.

Billed for the Internet Championship though the title had already been decided the same night by the separate six-man battle royal (order 3), a contradiction the fed's own text never resolves. A hockey stick hung above the barbwire-roped ring served as the match's own stipulated prize; Killerwolf reached it first for the win.
For the vacated International Championship. Gorilla knocked out the referee going for a cover; a groggily revived referee completed a slow three-count for Gorilla's own second cover attempt.
World Heavyweight Title match. Jaymac ran in late, first taking a chair away from Tiger as if to stop him, then turning and leveling Awesome with it instead — clearing the pin for Hellwolf to retain.
